planning_notes: The request for 5 HARD targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available pool and assigning each a unique, high-cognitive-load pedagogical facet. To ensure non-redundancy and high difficulty, I avoided simple recall (REMEMBER/UNDERSTAND) and focused on ANALYZE and EVALUATE levels. The facets chosen (OFF_BY_ONE_ANALYSIS, THEORETICAL_RATIONALE, ERROR_DIAGNOSIS, BOUNDARY_EDGE_CASE, and COMPLEXITY_ANALYSIS) target the most common failure points in Binary Search and Partitioning logic, ensuring deep assessment of the 'why' and 'how' rather than just the 'what'.
